caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The chair features a detailed backrest with ornate, curved patterns and cut-out designs, finished in a reddish-brown wood tone. The seat of the chair is depicted in a dark gray or black color, resembling a cushioned or upholstered surface. The legs of the chair are straight and sturdy, connected by horizontal support bars, also rendered in the same reddish-brown wood color as the rest of the chair. There are no additional objects or decorations present in the composition. The artist's signature, "Henry Grant," is visible in red at the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Chair
